short_description: Qualified accounting connections, cited context, and controlled Skills.
long_description: Mercury Finance is one OAuth-protected hosted MCP for cited accounting knowledge, provider connections, qualified capabilities, and controlled accounting Skills. First use opens a secure Mercury sign-in. Provider credentials are encrypted server-side and never enter chat, model, RAG, log, or audit output. A document create requires the exact qualified capability, an immutable preview, and explicit confirmation; Mercury never claims arbitrary provider writes.
developer_identity_instruction: Select the verified individual or business identity from the publishing OpenAI organization.
data_handling_summary: Mercury stores tenant-bound workspace and connection metadata, encrypted server-side provider credentials, qualified capability evidence, sanitized audit events, and cited knowledge references. Provider credentials never enter chat, model, RAG, log, or audit output. Mercury does not store raw provider credentials in submission data or request them in conversation.
independence_notice: Mercury Finance is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with Mercury Technologies, Inc.
